006a99e0.note: CGxDeviceD3d::IXformSetViewport, found by running --diff on IStateSync: every other callee matched in order and this showed as the one unlinked `- 006a99e0`. STATUS faithful BY HAND, because the branch-shape check misjudges this one. The reference has four branches and frozen has one, but two of the four are not control flow at all: they reload X and Y as signed 32-bit and add 4294967296.0 (2^32, the constant at 0x009e23ac) when negative, which is only the x87 idiom for converting a DWORD to floating point. 00683fb0.note: CGxLight::CGxLight. DIVERGED: frozen has no such function. The reference constructor writes the CGxLight defaults -- direction (0, 0, 1), black ambient, white diffuse, black specular and attenuation (0, 0.7, 0.03) -- and frozen expresses every one of those as a default member initializer on the struct instead, so the compiler emits them at the construction site and there is no callee to link. This entry used to say unlinked because, as its own note put it, adding a counterpart meant adding the state and its public setter rather than just this function. That is a correct resting state, not a stub: there is no caller whose control flow assumes it did something. GxRs_ClipPlaneMask (18) is the separate half that ENABLES planes and travels the ordinary render-state path as Ds_ClipPlaneEnable. 006a38d0.note: Its identity comes from the D3D9 device vtable offset it calls through: divide by four for the IDirect3DDevice9 method index. 0x12c / 4 = 75 = SetScissorRect, and the four ints it builds on the stack are a RECT clamped against the window size. Named to match the GL backend, which already had CGxDeviceGLL::IStateSyncScissorRect. Ported 2026-09-23 together with the state and setter it needed. Horizontal edges scale by DeviceCurWindow().maxX and vertical by .maxY -- the reference reaches the rect through FUN_00682d70, which is just `return &this->[0x174]`, and CRect is {minY, minX, maxY, maxX} so +0x8 is maxY and +0xc is maxX. Left and top take +0.5 (the constant at 0x009e2ec4, read out of .rdata), right and bottom +1.0. Vertical orientation flips on `+0x2918 != 0 || +0x2924 != 0`: with neither set the frame is the back buffer and top/bottom come from 1.0 - maxY and 1.0 - minY; otherwise they are used directly. IXformSetViewport flips y the same way. DIVERGENCE: those two are not the m_texture fields. Device create zeroes six consecutive dwords from +0x2910 to +0x2924, which is TextureTarget m_textureTarget[2] based at +0x2910, so +0x2918 and +0x2924 are the two m_apiSpecific fields (the reference stores one at 0x0068b929, indexing 0x2918(%edi,%eax,4) with eax = i*3). frozen tests m_texture instead, because RenderTargetSet fills m_texture and m_plane and IRenderTargetSet releases the surface without ever storing it -- testing the faithful field would make the branch permanently false and the render-to-texture case dead. Closing it properly means keeping the surface in m_apiSpecific, a lifetime change that wants a run. The dirty flag starts at 1 over an all-zero rect (device create loads 1 at 0x00688e64, the same register that initialises intF6C), so the first sync sends an empty rectangle. Harmless and faithful: D3DRS_SCISSORTESTENABLE follows GxRs_ScissorTest, which defaults to 0, so nothing clips until something enables the test and sets a rect. BUILT, NOT SEEN RUNNING.
